niche_preference_profile: This user most often prefers cleaner, more spacious interfaces with clear hierarchy, restrained visual clutter, and either light neutral palettes with soft purple/pastel accents or dark themes only when they are high-contrast and not flashy. They repeatedly favor simple sectioned layouts, strong readability, a single clearly emphasized primary action, rounded components, and contextual information presented in an organized way. They tend to reject dense stacking, competing calls-to-action, ornamental graphics, neon/glowy accents, heavy shadows, and visually noisy card treatments.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light neutral backgrounds with soft purple/pastel accents most consistently, but also responds positively to dark themes when they use strong contrast and avoid flashy neon treatment.
Prefers open spacing, breathing room, and calmer layouts with fewer competing elements rather than dense, tightly stacked, or visually busy screens.
Prefers interfaces where titles, metadata, status, and supporting details are clearly structured and easy to scan, with stronger organization of rows, cards, and sections.
Prefers one obvious, high-contrast primary CTA with strong action hierarchy, rather than multiple competing buttons, badges, or calls-to-action.
Prefers flat or lightly styled components with subtle borders, low shadow, less ornamental decoration, and polished but restrained visual treatment.
Prefers softer, more rounded cards, controls, and pill-like shapes over sharper or more rigid component geometry.
Prefers explicit navigation and status/context cues such as labeled bottom navigation, subtitles, verbal status labels, progress indicators, and richer contextual metadata.
